notes.title: 'Deep Pockets' Update Preview
notes.content:
[h1]'Deep Pockets' Update[/h1][p]Some people in Blomkest have deep pockets...and others deep secrets. Discover new ways to spend your hard-earned shills once the main story is finished, embark on a new questline, and uncover who's been pulling threads behind the scenes...

This update will give you some new things to do once you've reached the ending, so read on to learn what's in store (no pun intended), and [b]how you can try it out [i]today[/i]![/b]

[/p][h2]Dig a Basement[/h2][p]You need more space and can't expand outward...so what about straight down? This update adds a new questline that sees you expanding Discounty once again. But as you've no doubt learned, nothing in Blomkest comes easy...and there might be some [i]other [/i]people in town who take an unexpected interest in your new basement project.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43640831/c5ff82199466d691c0d3f0fa12e0726000a65fef.png"][/img][i]Nothing to see here.[/i]

[/p][h2]Level Up Your Shop![/h2][p]Don't let your Discounty Rewards Points go to waste! We're adding a few new items to the Rewards Shop, including a new post-game category with some cool new ways to boost your efficiency and profits!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43640831/4d715e72a9fe738277fd4c96ff83934fdf2a495c.png"][/img]
[/p][h2]A New Coat of Paint[/h2][p]Solruna has been experimenting with extracting the essences of color, and believes a new coat of colored paint might be [i]just [/i]the thing to purge the negative energies Discounty brought to town. In a new quest, you will learn how to transmute items from your store into new colors for the shop exterior. For a price, of course.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43640831/3ba64a5e8667d94c6933641aae31d98fdde3b8c5.gif"][/img]
[/p][h2]Quality of Life & Bug Fixes[/h2][p]We're also throwing in a bunch of quality of life improvements and bug fixes! Some highlights include the ability to swap back to the cash register after upgrading the scanner, improvements to Chester's behavior, clarifying certain quests, and much more!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43640831/a190112519a246a6b4b429d45f4abcd018a1df90.png"][/img]
[/p][h2]Try the Public Beta![/h2][p]Sound exciting? Well, good news: [b]you can try it out right now![/b] We've added a new Steam branch that will allow you to test updates so you can let us know what you think before it goes out to everyone!

[b][u]We highly recommend backing up your saves before playing the public beta branch![/u][/b] To do so, back up the files in the following folder: %USERPROFILE%/AppData/LocalLow/Crinkle Cut Games/Discounty.[/p][p]  To access the branch: [/p][list][*][p] Go to your Steam library and find Discounty
[/p][/*][*][p] Right click the game and click "Properties"
[/p][/*][*][p] In the Properties window, go to the Beta tab, and select the "publicbeta" branch from the drop-down menu.
[/p][/*][/list][p]For now, the [b]beta is only available in English[/b]. However, we will be adding all the other languages soon. To get notified of updates, watch our news page for patch notes, or [url="https://discord.gg/7T8hCmKDsw"]join our Discord [/url] and choose the Public Beta role for pings! This Discord is also the best place to give feedback about the beta.

[b]And remember to back up your saves![/b]

[/p][h2][i]Also:[/i] We Have a Wiki![/h2][p]Need help giving gifts to rats, infusing apples, or figuring out the most profitable items?

Learn more — or help write a guide — in our brand new Wiki, hosted by wiki.gg! We've been working on this with a few community members over the last few days. Since we expect [i]Discounty [/i] will continue to grow for a long time, we want to build this up and make it the [b]ultimate resource for all things Discounty[/b].

But we need YOUR help: check out the [b][url="https://discounty.wiki.gg/"]Official Discounty Wiki[/url][/b] now!

[/p][h1]Patch Notes: Version 1.1.0 Beta[/h1][p]
[b]🛒 = this change was suggested by players! [/b]

[/p][h3]Quests[/h3][list][*][p][b]Discounty Basement[/b]: Adds a multi-part questline, starting in Chapter 2 and continuing into the endgame, in which the player can add a basement to their store.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]The Boiling Brew[/b]: Adds a quest that introduces you Solruna's new experiments with paint. Can be started after seeing Solruna's final friendship event.
[/p][/*][*][p] 🛒 Corporate Espionage: the stealth route is shorter, and now spawns automatically when player is in the forest between 19:00 and 20:00.
[/p][/*][*][p] 🛒 Beyond the Fog: reduced the firewood Elmer requires to 1 piece, and clarified quest text.
[/p][/*][*][p] 🛒 An Apple of the Occult: changed wording of objective to reduce player confusion.
[/p][/*][*][p] 🛒 The Fishy Fisherman: players can now speak with Barbara to get more Fishmas Sticks if needed.
[/p][/*][/list][h3]Shop:[/h3][list][*][p] Basement: players can unlock a basement, giving extra storage space for item boxes, shelves, and decorations.
[/p][/*][*][p] 🛒 Scanner can now be toggled back to cash register using the PC.
[/p][/*][*][p] 🛒 Chester won't steal: fixed bug that could cause items Chester holds to be lost when the player leaves the store.
[/p][/*][*][p] Chester can now place items back in boxes if all shelves are full and he's got nothing better to do.
[/p][/*][*][p] 🛒 Improved scanner tutorial to clarify the controls.
[/p][/*][*][p] 🛒 Customers now queue based on proximity to the cash register, rather than the order in which they finish their shopping lists. No more cutting in line!
[/p][/*][*][p] 🛒 Trash compactor lights now indicate what type of waste they contain.
[/p][/*][*][p] Added a red-tinted "0" to empty shelves.
[/p][/*][*][p] 🛒 Players can no longer place items behind fridges. Already-placed items can be picked up.
[/p][/*][/list][h3]New Rewards Shop Items[/h3][list][*][p] Improved Sponge: can be used 3 times before wetting again.
[/p][/*][*][p] Ultimate Sponge: can be used 4 times before wetting again.
[/p][/*][*][p] Discounty Bucket: bucket no longer has an appeal penalty
[/p][/*][*][p] Advanced Employee Shoes: Chester moves faster.
[/p][/*][*][p] Premium Employee Shoes: Chester moves even faster
[/p][/*][*][p] Employee Gloves: Chester restocks faster.
[/p][/*][*][p] Premium Employee Gloves: Chester restocks even faster.
[/p][/*][*][p] Category Discounts: get a discount when purchasing items in a particular category. Each category discount has 4 tiers.
[/p][/*][/list][h3]Dialogues[/h3][list][*][p] Guy will no longer introduce himself in Chapter 2 and beyond.
[/p][/*][*][p] 🛒 Derek can no longer talk about his workday before getting to work.
[/p][/*][*][p] Karl no longer mentions the tea shop destruction early.
[/p][/*][*][p] Ted and Solruna will now kick you out of their shops if you stay too late.
[/p][/*][/list][h3]Visuals[/h3][list][*][p] Added opening hours signs to all shops and trade deal vendors.
[/p][/*][*][p] Improved look of the green sea.
[/p][/*][*][p] Multiple aquariums no longer have synchronized movement.
[/p][/*][*][p] Added particle effect when the PC is unpacked
[/p][/*][/list][h3]User Interface[/h3][list][*][p] 🛒 Character customization options are now numbered.
[/p][/*][*][p] Added "Scan" command & button when using the scanner
[/p][/*][*][p] Added progress bar to the Rewards Shop showing how many new items have been unlocked.
[/p][/*][/list][h3]Other[/h3][list][*][p] Reduced the number of colliders and volumetric lighting sources in town to increase performance.
[/p][/*][*][p] Players can no longer immediately go to bed; can only sleep at 9:30 or later on all days.
[/p][/*][*][p] Ted's opening hours are now properly set to the times listed.
[/p][/*][*][p] Solruna now closes her shop at 20:00, to leave to parts unknown...
[/p][/*][*][p] Post-credits popup has now been changed to Player dialogue.
[/p][/*][/list][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p] 🛒 Fixed customers getting stuck when doors to the warehouse are blocked.
[/p][/*][*][p] 🛒 Fixed players getting stuck in hay bales near farm.
[/p][/*][*][p] 🛒 Fixed players getting stuck next to Fisher's mailbows.
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed Ms. Andersen looking out her window when she's outside in some instances.
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed Elmer's fireplace not being lit when it should be.
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed unaligned walls in shop.
[/p][/*][*][p] Removed extra pixels in James' sprite.
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed game pausing time after opening & closing sewer menus.
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed gap in visual boundary around shop.
[/p][/*][*][p] 🛒 Chester's third friendship event is no longer available during Blomkest Fair, which could cause a soft lock.
[/p][/*][*][p] 🛒 Small potted tree now only spawns in the back slot at Solruna's store.
[/p][/*][*][p] 🛒 Fixed bird bath not returning to normal after finishing the related quest.
[/p][/*][*][p] 🛒 Advanced trade deal items can no longer be selected before they're unlocked.
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed bucket spawning too early.
[/p][/*][*][p] 🛒 Expand and Conquer quest: Elmer's documents can no longer spawn in a way that can trap players.
[/p][/*][*][p] 🛒 Fixed rat bowl spawning too soon.
[/p][/*][/list][p]We hope you're excited for the update! :)

xoxo
Crinkle Cut Games[/p]

notes.title: Discounty Patch 2 - Version 1.0.2
notes.content:
[b]Attention, shoppers![/b] 

Discounty's second major patch is here! We've been able to include some of our community's most-requested features and squash many of the remaining critical bugs, including:
[list]
[*] A faster and skippable end-of-day report.
[*] Players getting stuck in numerous locations.
[*] Time skipping ahead too far in the post-game.
[*] ...and Elmer is less of a creep.
[/list]
Check out the full patch notes below. [i](This Patch, along with all previous patches, is now being ported to consoles as well!)[/i] Thanks again to everyone who's been providing feedback: since we are just a four-person studio, [b]your reports have been immensely helpful to us and we are so grateful![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43640831/c81c7dc4bbe422c4da42fdf7fb101a6c2c3dc437.gif[/img]

[h2]What's Next?[/h2]
We're already working on our next major update, which will include more polish, bug fixes, and highly-requested quality-of-life features -- like the ability to switch back to the standard cash register after unlocking the scanner. But more excitingly: [b]the next update will also include new content to expand the endgame and give you more reasons to continue playing![/b] While we can't promise any specifics right now, we hope to drop this update about a month from now, so keep an eye out for more info soon!

[b]If you haven't yet, could you please take a moment to review the game on Steam?[/b] A good rating helps us support the game for as long as possible! 🙏

[h2]Discounty Patch Notes Version 1.0.2[/h2]

[b]🛒 = this change was suggested by players! [/b]
[i](You'll notice that almost every item has a 🛒 next to it -- huge shout-out to everyone in our community who's been reporting bugs & helping us diagnose them!)[/i]

[h3]Shop:[/h3]
[list]
[*]🛒 End of day report runs faster the more items it displays.
[*]🛒 End of day report can now be skipped section by section.
[*]🛒 Fixed players getting not being able to order more items when they've ordered a full truck of items but allow Guy to leave, potentially hard-locking the game.
[*]🛒 Fixed confused customers getting frozen or stuck.
[*]🛒 Fixed scanner not registering pressing "up" if the first item has an up-facing barcode.
[*]🛒 Fixed the scanner not responding to D-pad down buttons on controllers.
[*]🛒 Bottomless coolers now properly appear in Ted's shop.
[/list]
[h3]Interactions:[/h3]
[list]
[*]🛒 Fixed inventory slots not properly activating when clicked with a mouse.
[*]🛒 Fixed Trade Deal crate perks not properly increasing the number of crates available.
[*]🛒 Players can now properly select vendor posters in the printer using a controller.
[*]🛒 Made it easier to interact with a friendship event item. [spoiler](Ted's drink at the bar.)[/spoiler]
[*]🛒 Fixed the clickable area not lining up with text when going to sleep.
[*] Fixed karaoke dialogue sometimes crashing the game.
[/list]
[h3]Cutscenes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Increased the time window in which it's possible to start the [spoiler]pipe cutscene.[/spoiler]
[/list]
[h3]Getting Stuck:[/h3]
[list]
[*]🛒 Fixed players getting stuck in the hedges next to the Lapleys' home.
[*]🛒 Fixed players getting stuck in crab pots at the harbor.
[*]🛒 Fixed players getting stuck behind Tellar's house.
[*]🛒 Fixed players getting stuck in the lamp post at the top of the harbor stairs.
[*]🛒 Fixed players getting stuck in the [spoiler]flock of sheep at the Blomkest Fair.[/spoiler]
[*]🛒 Fixed players getting stuck in mailboxes.
[*]🛒 Fixed players getting stuck in Elmer's hedge.
[*]🛒 Fixed players getting stuck in the rocks outside the mine.
[*]🛒 Fixed players getting stuck in trees in multiple locations in the forest.
[*]🛒 Fixed players getting stuck in farm fields.
[*]🛒 Fixed players getting stuck in crates near Fisher's boat.
[/list]
[h3]Dialogues, schedules & quests:[/h3]
[list]
[*]🛒 Fixed Elmer relentlessly hitting on the player. (This dialogue now only plays once as intended.)
[*]🛒 Fixed two friendship events spawning at the same time leading to a soft lock.
[*]🛒 Fixed various issues with the Corporate Espionage quest that could soft lock players who started the quest on a Sunday.
[*]🛒 Fixed soft-locking the game if you clicked on [spoiler]Fluffles[/spoiler] first when painting sheep in the Karl's second trade deal quest.
[*]🛒 Fixed issue with players needing to start “Operating as a Real Supermarket” by going to the farm, rather than being able to start any of the trade deal vendor quests.
[*]🛒 Fixed issue with players being soft-locked during Tammy's third trade deal quest.
[*]🛒 Fixed players being soft-locked due to the clock reaching midnight during a scene transition in Tammy's first trade deal quest.
[*]🛒 Fixed issue with Ms. Andersen being able to speak about [spoiler]Fishy Fishes[/spoiler] early.
[*]🛒 Fixed issue with Ted's third friendship event object [spoiler](drink on bar)[/spoiler] not being clickable.
[*]🛒 Solruna's third friendship event is now correctly displayed as taking place in the forest int he Customer tab.
[*]🛒 Adjusted dialogue during Tammy's third trade deal quest to clarify that Elmer needs three pieces of wood instead of one.
[*]🛒 Fixed Hilda's third friendship event item being highlighted before the player has seen the first two events.
[*]🛒 Fixed HIlda's second friendship event crashing in Spanish.
[/list]
[h3]System/Settings:[/h3]
[list]
[*]🛒 Fixed game skipping ahead by 3 days every sleep after the end credits.
[/list]
[h3]Typos:[/h3]
[list]
[*]🛒 Fixed Spanish & Japanese localizations listing the store's opening hours as 8:00 instead of 9:00.
[*]🛒 Fixed English text present in Barbara's third trade deal event in the German version.
[*]🛒 Tammy's menu
[*]🛒 Graces first friendship event
[*]🛒 Printer upgrade dialogue
[*]🛒 Hilda's intro dialogue
[*]🛒 Ted's first friendship event
[/list]

Thank you for shopping at Discounty!
xoxo
Crinkle Cut Games

notes.title: 100,000 Copies Sold! What's Next?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43640831/98ed26aa2d2d4d343b7561e19e7cd5a18f535baa.gif[/img]
[i][b]I wish Chester hadn't called out sick today.[/b][/i]

[h2]100,000 Copies Sold![/h2]
The checkout line is moving fast: just one week after launch, Discounty has officially sold over 100,000 copies worldwide across all platforms!

Thank you for making this one of the most incredible weeks of our lives. 🫶 

We're so happy you love the game, and [b]your support will allow us to keep developing free content updates in the months to come and beyond[/b]—stay tuned to learn more!

[h2]What's Next for Discounty?[/h2]
We've spent almost 5 years working on Discounty so far, and we're not ready to stop yet! And thanks to your incredible support, we will be able [b]to bring free content updates to the game for a long time to come.[/b] While we can't give any specifics quite yet, many of these will be focused on expanding [b]endgame content and replayability[/b]. And Blomkest still has its share of mysteries yet to be solved...
[h3]Patch 2[/h3]
Before we add any new content, we still want to put a lot of polish on the game, while adding some of your most-requested quality of life and accessibility features. We're currently putting the final touches on Patch 2, which we'll then begin testing. This will include dozens of small fixes and improvements, but most importantly: [b]a faster and skippable end-of-day report! [/b] This definitely won't be the last patch, so please keep your feedback and bug reports coming!

[h2]Please Leave a Review![/h2]
If you haven't yet, please take a moment to leave a review for Discounty here on Steam! A higher rating helps more people discover our game, ensuring we can continue supporting it for a long time to come!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43640831/4066cbc911e8ba4b7daf7aa2ad22f09aca1a6552.gif[/img]

[h2]Discounty Soundtrack on YouTube[/h2]
In real life retail workers get sick of the music they hear again and again while working. But not at Discounty! 🎶

Now you can listen to our original soundtrack anytime on YouTube! (And of course, you can also buy it here on Steam!)
[previewyoutube=_xI1nG5jvFg;full][/previewyoutube]

That's all for now! Keep up your great work, Employee! 

xoxo
Crinkle Cut Games

notes.title: Discounty Patch 1 - Version 1.0.1

[b]Attention, shoppers![/b]

notes.title: 💌 Discounty News - July 2025 (+ Price Announcement!)
notes.content:
Hello shoppers!

Things are really exciting here at Crinkle Cut, because Discounty is FINALLY launching in less than one month.

Well, let's get into it before I start screaming. 😱 This is a condensed version of our July email newsletter. Make sure to [url=https://crinklecutgames.com/newsletter]subscribe to our newsletter[/url] for the full version — new subscribers get the latest issue in their inbox! Here are the highlights:

[h2]💸 Price Announcement[/h2]
A lot of you have been waiting on this news. We can finally give you an anwser:

[b]Discounty will cost $19.99 USD on Steam[/b] (or your equivalent local price!).
 
But it wouldn't be Discounty without a discount! [b]There be a 20% launch discount on Steam for two weeks[/b]. That means you can get Discounty for under 16 bucks! Wow!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43640831/cf3458140b5b4d900c3c60c89453c37fb7d1cf74.png[/img]
We're offering a big discount in the hope that lots of people can finally play our game right away. [b]We know some of you have been waiting over two years for this game to come out.[/b] Plus, the more early support we get, the more likely we'll be able to continue supporting Discounty and bringing you more content. Thanks for being along with us on this ride. 🙏

[h2]✅ Demo Patch![/h2]
We wrote about this [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2274620/Discounty/]previously on Steam[/url], but in case you missed it: we released a big patch for our demo on Steam, adding Japanese, Korean, and Simplified & Traditional Chinese, lots of decorative items, faster running, and more requests from our community! You can [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2274620/view/545615175941619935?l=english]check out the patch notes here.[/url]

[h2]🦝 Discord Meme Contest[/h2]
Since we announced our Discord server in our last newsletter, our community has quickly grown to over 750 members! We want to keep that community growing by offering lots of activities, so here's our next Employee of the Month challenge: a meme contest!

The rules are simple: make a meme about Discounty, we'll choose our favorites, and the community will choose a winner.

You can find the full rules in our server: [url=https://discord.gg/7T8hCmKDsw]join the Discord[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43640831/5114f2ecca2e6a5107a2ae186629ee0590dfa423.png[/img]
[b]That's it for this month's dev update![/b] If you want to read more, make sure to [url=https://crinklecutgames.com/newsletter]sign up for the newsletter here[/url]. Thanks for reading, and see you in August!

xoxo
Crinkle Cut Games

notes.title: Employee Training Video: Customer Relations ❤️
notes.content:
You call it "friendship"; at Discounty, we call it [b]Customer Relations.[/b]

In the latest episode of our [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ow0BcFuFjUQ&list=PLhH91b78YZ3vUD4Hp9aCKVlH_H5H27-Hn][b]Employee Training Video Series[/b][/url], we talk about the tangible benefits of maintaining relationships with your customers.

Learn to see every personal interaction as a chance to improve your bottom line!

[previewyoutube=0E0KLt8OWE0;full][/previewyoutube]
[i](Video narrated by [url=https://www.youtube.com/@PaytonsCorner]Payton's Corner[/url])[/i]

[h2]Tiny Devlog: Opening the Store[/h2]

As we wrote last week, we've been making a few tweaks to the game in response to player feedback from our demo. We noticed a lot of players didn't realize that it's possible to skip time ahead to the beginning of your shift by interacting with the computer in the back of the store. We wanted to find a couple ways to make this clearer and give players more control over how they spend their time.

Most notably, we've added a new open/closed sign to the front of the store so that you can jump right into the action, without even having to walk to the back of the store. And we've added a new tutorial for using the sign in the full game. Check out the cute new sign:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43640831/5bd375edfcbe0c43fb13646d95cddb50d37cd1dc.gif[/img]

Here's your regularly scheduled reminder that you can still play our demo:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3731830/
xoxo

notes.title: 💌 Discounty News - May 2025
notes.content:
Attention shoppers!

First of all, to everyone eagerly awaiting more news about Discounty's launch, all I have to say is: stay tuned! 👀

In the meantime, we wanted to share a few development updates pulled from our most recent email newsletter. Make sure to [url=https://crinklecutgames.com/newsletter]subscribe to our newsletter[/url] for the full version — new subscribers get the latest issue in their inbox!

[h2]🎉 A MAZE. Festival: Making a playable demo![/h2]
As we wrote in our last newsletter update, Discounty was nominated for an A MAZE. Award at the A MAZE. Festival in Berlin this year. That also included the opportunity to showcase the game at the Exhibition, along with all the other nominated games.

Because of that, we had to make a demo version of the game! We wanted to show off some of the best parts of the early game in a short demo that could be completed in a half hour. We threw one together then got it all set up at the festival. We met so many cool people, and that alone was worth the trip!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43640831/2124837f9abac5e258b45d492c9e2f79426e9fb4.png[/img]
[h2]🌐 LOCALIZATION: Discounty goes global![/h2]
We want as many people as possible to play Discounty, which means we need to localize the game! That means translating every bit of text — from dialogue to quest logs to UI — into a bunch of different languages.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43640831/46affbcd808edb3e4f243f80d9e392d813095853.png[/img]
If that sounds like a lot of work...it is! Thankfully, our publisher is working with localizers to bring the game into all of our target languages. (By the way, these are English, French, German, Spanish (Spain), Japanese, Korean, Portuguese (Brazil), Simplified & Traditional Chinese, and Danish.)

But getting the text translated isn't the end of it. After we got the translations back, we've had to make sure they're re-implemented into the game properly. Translations can unexpectedly break code, longer words can extend outside of text boxes, and there are sometimes lines that might not get implemented properly since we have a massive & confusing text database. But it will definitely be worth it when fans all over the world can play the game in their native language!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43640831/454a42918f775c511c221b0e56a16888d4e19dc8.png[/img]
[h2]💬 Mods? ...Mods??[/h2]
As a reward for reading to the last entry, we're going to let you in on a little secret…we’re going to open a Discord server for Discounty very soon! The Discord is going to be a crucial place for us as developers to gather feedback to improve the game. If you want to be a part of making Discounty into the best possible game it can be, keep your eyes peeled here and on our social media channels for more info in the coming days!

That's it for this month's dev update! If you want to read more, make sure to [url=https://crinklecutgames.com/newsletter]sign up for the newsletter here[/url]. Thanks for reading, and see you next month!

xoxo
Crinkle Cut Games

notes.title: 💌 Discounty News - April 2025
notes.content:
Attention shoppers!

We recently sent out our [url=https://crinklecutgames.com/newsletter]April newsletter[/url]! A LOT has been happening in the last few months, so we're excited to finally spill the tea a bit. So here's an excerpt from our last email about what we've been up to! Make sure to [url=https://crinklecutgames.com/newsletter]subscribe to our newsletter[/url] for the full version — new subscribers get the latest issue in their inbox!

[h2]🎉 TAGS Event in Copenhagen[/h2]
We recently showed our game to the public for the first time EVER! In February we had the opportunity to show Discounty as part of Copenhagen Gaming Week. Our core team is located in Denmark, but we were able to bring in our publishing team and social/comms manager Ian, and it was actually the first time we all got to meet together in person! It was really special to chat with each other while watching random people trying Discounty, while also getting useful feedback to improve the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43640831/643ac4fe929b15efc9412936acb7d5a0a036c3e7.png[/img]
[h2]🧪 PLAYTESTING: Getting your feedback [/h2]
We've also had our first closed playtests since our last newsletter! We invited a small number of testers to play the first two hours of Discounty. As they played, they provided ongoing commentary and reactions to everything they experienced. We are currently preparing for a much larger-scale playtest in the next couple months, so stay tuned if you've signed up already, or join our newsletter to get the signup link!

[h2]🪞 CHARACTER CREATOR: Be who you want[/h2]
Our much-anticipated character creation system is now fully implemented! There are 6 categories you can adjust to change your character's appearance, each with a wide range of color options. Behold:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43640831/cf6ce1bf980f8a8f6787625e0ade556b09a30a7e.gif[/img]
[h2]🎵 Meet the Team: James (Music)[/h2]
About Me: I’m a working musician in London but for the last 5 years I’ve been composing music and doing audio for games! It was an easy bridge of two of my passions! Bringing worlds to life and bouncing ideas off a dev team has been an absolute joy. Especially inside the indie game scene where such amazing art and game design really helps fuel the music I can make. I love working with soundfonts and working around their limitations but also any excuse to make something grandiose is never out of the question!

[h2]🏆 Some A MAZE.-ing News[/h2]
Discounty has been nominated for an A MAZE. Award! We are honored to be nominated for the WINGS Award, presented by WINGS Fund, which recognizes games made by teams with women & gender-marginalized developers in key positions, like us!

As part of the nomination, we'll be able to exhibit a demo of Discounty throughout the event from May 14-17 in Berlin. So if you happen to live in the area and want to give Discounty a try, please come by. (And congrats to our fellow nominees! So many cool games!!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43640831/34c047dbe2a1a670d1e1d7c4ac9981fc824a659e.jpg[/img]
[h2]👋 Until Next Time[/h2]
That's it for now, but since we're getting ever closer to the game's release later this year, we're going to start sending out these newsletters every month. Subscribers get these updates first, and with twice as much content, so make sure to [url=https://crinklecutgames.com/newsletter]sign up here[/url]! Thanks for reading, and see you next month!

xoxo
Crinkle Cut Games

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43640831/38f6bad39ff50aeeb8cfc2c0ef692debb7e67ec0.gif[/img]

notes.title: 🛍️ Discounty Devlog: What We've Been Working On Lately
notes.content:
Hello shoppers,

It's been a while since we last updated you here about what we've been working on, so we wanted to give you a quick little peek behind the scenes! But first: we'd like to give a special thanks to all the mystery shoppers who participated in our recent [b]Closed Playtesting[/b] for Discounty. We'll be doing another, larger round of playtesting soon, so if you missed out on the last round, make sure to [url=https://crinklecutgames.com/newsletter]sign up for our newsletter[/url] for more details.

[h2]What We've Been Up To[/h2]
In the last few months we've been working hard to finalize all of the systems in the game. That means doing a lot of the "boring" things that nevertheless have to get done. For example, we finally added multiple save slots into the game, which is of course very important, but maybe not so interesting to talk about:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43640831/0f014998569a65c865f9efab7d0da01efc17edd4.png[/img]
On the more exciting side, we've also been expanding our rotating cast of shoppers who come into Discounty. You've got a lot of customers to serve, and not all of them are locals. Blomkest is conveniently located on the highway, and your bright billboard lures in many commuters every day. To make sure your store feels full and varied, we needed to have lots of unique NPCs who could stop in to shop. For a while, many of these customers have been creepy clones of each other — but no more! Here's a sneak peek of some of the new NPCs:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43640831/057a94606979bde2f151d0751d5dda82530d40e1.png[/img]
We've also put the finishing touches on our Challenges system. These are daily and weekly goals you can complete in your store, like selling X cartons of milk in a day, or ordering a certain number of boxes of fish. This encourages players to continually optimize their stores to earn reward points to unlock more wares, expand their inventories, and more:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43640831/958ffdbde307d1e0d86bd9dc0b1039a7fd5a319b.png[/img]

[h2]🧾 What’s Next?[/h2]
Behind the scenes, we’ve been working on the next newsletter, some new game refinements, and a few things we can’t quite talk about just yet. But we promise: there’s plenty more in store for Discounty, and you're going to start hearing from us a lot more frequently in the coming months.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43640831/0cb24dd7332a822c39ab148489642e61ef506b27.gif[/img]

Keep an eye on this space for updates, announcements, and more chances to step into the world we’re creating. [b]And please: let us know what you'd like to see from us![/b] Until then, [i]thank you for being part of the journey[/i]!

xoxo
Crinkle Cut Games
